title: Code and aggregated results for: Causal Validation of Knowledge-Tracing Models with Naturally Randomized Item Exposure in Game-Based Learning
description: Analysis code (Python) and aggregated results for the article 'Causal Validation of Knowledge-Tracing Models with Naturally Randomized Item Exposure in Game-Based Learning' (Machine Learning and Knowledge Extraction, submitted). The study uses a natural experiment in the logs of a game-based quiz platform to estimate the causal effect of a previous encounter with an item and its decay over time, and compares the effects implied by fourteen knowledge-tracing models with this reference. The response data are not included because they contain records of minors; the repository contains all scripts and only aggregated outputs (effect estimates, covariance matrices, model-implied curves, metrics and bootstrap summaries) without learner, game or item identifiers.
